variants.title: DC SQUID V-flux with a 0.30 nH/mA input coil (simulated instrument)
variants.sample: DC SQUID (simulated), coil mutual inductance 3.0e-10 Wb/A
variants.note: A tighter coupling gives a shorter period in coil current (about 6.9 uA).

source.title: Clarke and Braginski, The SQUID Handbook vol. I, chapter 2 (the symmetric DC SQUID, beta_L << 1)

variants.title: DC SQUID V-flux with a 0.10 nH/mA input coil (simulated instrument)
variants.sample: DC SQUID (simulated), coil mutual inductance 1.0e-10 Wb/A
variants.note: A looser coupling needs a longer sweep: the period is about 20.7 uA.

source.title: Clarke and Braginski, The SQUID Handbook vol. I, chapter 2 (the symmetric DC SQUID, beta_L << 1)

variants.title: DC SQUID V-flux with a noisier amplifier (simulated instrument)
variants.sample: DC SQUID (simulated), voltage noise 0.6 uV per reading
variants.unknown: flux quantum and the flux noise
variants.note: Three times the voltage noise: the flux quantum is still found from the crossings, and the flux noise is three times larger.

source.title: Clarke and Braginski, The SQUID Handbook vol. I, chapter 2 (the symmetric DC SQUID, beta_L << 1)
